$comment: Unified perf budget (#795). Single source of truth for vite chunk caps, server histogram buckets (server/telemetry.js), Playwright field profile (playwright.config.js), load-test SLOs and the perf:budget verdict (scripts/perf-budget.mjs). Numbers are baselines + 20% headroom; owners must sign off on changes.

bytesToMs.$comment: Parse+compile ms per KB of JS (gzip-decoded) on the field profile. Placeholder coefficients until fitted from 5 chunk sizes; see docs/telemetry-architecture.md. Error bound is the fit's 95% CI half-width.

chunks.$comment: KB caps (raw, pre-gzip) derived from bundleParse via bytesToMs. Matched against dist/assets/<name>-<hash>.js. `initial` is everything the entry HTML loads.
